summary: Alvotech filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 financial results and business update via press release dated November 11, 2026. Adjusted total revenue was $323.4 million versus $420.0 million a year earlier, gross margin 54% versus 59%, adjusted EBITDA $78.3 million versus $68.0 million, and cash fell to $61.5 million from $172.4 million at year-end 2025. Operational highlights include FDA acceptance of the AVT80 vedolizumab biosimilar BLA. No transaction, capital return, board change or strategic event is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings current report with no deal terms.
